create_nash_conv: create a NashConv instance to compute the Nash Conv metric for a mean field game policy
run_nash_conv: run the nash_conv method to get the Nash Conv value for a policy against its own distribution
run_br_values: run the br_values method to get best response values for each root state of the policy distribution
access_distribution: access the distribution property to retrieve the DistributionPolicy object from a NashConv instance
test_nash_conv: test the NashConv class by initializing it with a game, policy, and optional root state
